settings.question: Does it need Wi-Fi?
settings.answer: No. MOOV connects to your phone over Bluetooth. No Wi-Fi, no account setup, no hub required. Pair it once and it just works.

settings.question: How loud does it get?
settings.answer: The alarm plays through your phone at full volume — loud enough to wake you from across the room. You control the volume in the app.

settings.question: What if I miss the alarm?
settings.answer: If you don't press the device within the snooze window, the alarm repeats through your phone. It keeps going until you physically press MOOV.

settings.question: Can I install it without drilling?
settings.answer: Yes. MOOV mounts with a 3M Command Strip — no screws, no damage. The wall block stays fixed; the device magnetically snaps on and off.

settings.question: Is there a subscription?
settings.answer: No. MOOV is a one-time purchase. The app is free. No monthly fees, no locked features.
